record_title: Sharp off-critical powers for discrete Fourier trace defects
provenance: A sharpness theorem for the off-critical powers in Theorem 2.2 and Remark 9.4 of Azita Mayeli, arXiv:2609.12226v1, using explicit balanced q-adic alternating-gap sets and the exact trace-defect identity.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The lower bounds hold along explicit lacunary sequences of scales, not as all-scale two-sided asymptotics. The critical fractional line gamma=eta<1 remains open here. The result concerns the trace defect and does not claim matching plunge-count lower bounds. The smoother member of each example has stronger regularity than the prescribed larger exponent. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
